landing.metaTitle: SiroQuizz: learn vocabulary with flashcards, tests and games

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.body: Flip cards, hear pronunciation, sort what you know from what you're still learning.

test.title: Tests your way
test.body: Multiple choice, true/false, written, matching. You pick the question types.

games.title: 4 games
games.body: Match, Gravity, Memory and Scramble. Studying that feels like playing.

ai.title: Create with AI
ai.body: Upload a PDF, Word file or a photo of your textbook and AI turns it into a set.

steps.three: Play games to review until it really sticks.
